search.startTyping: Type to search chapters, sections, and exercises.
search.keyboardHint: Use ↑ ↓ to navigate and Enter to open

landing.hero: Interactive study guide based on Jimmy Song's acclaimed book. Explore all 14 chapters with in-browser runnable Python code, self-assessment quizzes, and key notes.
landing.footer: Based on Programming Bitcoin: Learn How to Program Bitcoin from Scratch by Jimmy Song.
landing.practiceDescription: Work through book exercises with an in-browser Python editor, automatic validation, and runnable examples.

practice.title: Practice
practice.subtitle: Solve book exercises and run coding examples in your browser. Edit Python on the right, read instructions on the left, and click Run to verify your solution.

exercise.offlineDescription: This exercise requires network access or a local Python environment. Read the instructions and try it on your machine using the official book repository.

progressBackup.title: Progress backup
progressBackup.description: Export your read chapters and exercise progress as a JSON file to use in another browser or on another device.
progressBackup.mergeDescription: Importing merges this backup with progress saved in this browser. Passed exercises stay passed.
progressBackup.exportError: Progress backup could not be downloaded.
progressBackup.fileTooLarge: The file exceeds the 1 MB size limit.
progressBackup.invalidFile: This is not a valid progress backup file.
progressBackup.unsupportedVersion: This progress backup version is not supported.
progressBackup.storageError: Progress could not be saved in this browser.

quiz.title: Check your understanding
quiz.description: Answer without looking at the formulas. If you miss one, use the explanation as a hint and revisit the related section.
quiz.question: Question {{current}} of {{total}}
quiz.good: Good effort: review the missed questions and try again.

code.clickRun: Click "Run" to execute the code with Pyodide.
